insurer_name: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Originally an L&T General Insurance product (now HDFC ERGO); PED waiting 48 months for legacy variant.

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Room rent, ICU, OT, anaesthesia, blood, oxygen, surgical appliances, drugs, diagnostics, implants.

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Home treatment > 3 days when transfer impossible or no room.

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Reimbursement up to 2x SI for listed Critical Illnesses.
critical_illness_cover.notes: Cancer (specific severity), Open CABG, Heart Attack (specific severity), Kidney Failure, Multiple Sclerosis with persisting symptoms, Major Organ/Bone Marrow Transplant, Stroke (with permanent symptoms), Aorta Graft Surgery, Primary Pulmonary Hypertension.

permanent_exclusions: Dental treatment unless arising from accident
notable_exclusions_summary: Comprehensive hospitalization plus built-in Critical Illness double-SI feature. PED waiting 48 months. Standard health insurance exclusions.
